name: Sensors for apps: accelerometer, gyroscope, compass, light, rotation
description: Replaces Huawei's sensor VDI (Kirin sensorhub) with one that talks to the Snapdragon Sensor Core on the ADSP over QRTR/QMI, the way Android's sensor HAL does: accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, ambient light, gravity (from the SSC or computed from the accelerometer, used for auto-rotation), rotation and game rotation vectors. Sensors appear a few seconds after boot, when the ADSP sensor domain is up. The proximity sensor of sweet is ultrasonic (audio DSP) and is not included.
